snippet.textDisplay: Cheating is one thing,  bringing home an STD is yet another, but bringing home a death sentence (basically what HIV/AIDS was back then) is another ball game. To cheat on your spouse/mate is bad enough, but to roll the dice and not use protection, is down right suicidal. I don't know I could ever get over the hurt and betrayal if my husband didn't give a crap about me, far less himself. Cheating and not using protection only proves he had absolute no impulse control. She's a way better woman than I would've been for staying with him.
